audio.strategy: One deterministic render pipeline (src/audio/render.ts + src/audio/effects.ts + src/audio/dsp.ts + src/audio/organ-models.ts + src/audio/synth-engine.ts + src/audio/synth-render.ts) serves both the browser and tests. Grand/Upright/Electric pianos play the bundled recorded sample library; Clav/Digital/Misc, the labeled fallback, all organ models, and all synth voices are honest live synthesis rendered per voice. The Web Audio backend pre-renders each voice through the exact shared graph (layer source → Mod 1 → Mod 2 → Delay → Amp/EQ/Filter → Compressor → per-voice frames) and plays it through six layer buses (pianoA, pianoB, organ [A+B shared], synthA/B/C), a live convolver reverb, layer level gains, master gain, and a DynamicsCompressor limiter to one destination on one AudioContext. The fake test backend runs the identical code offline at 8 kHz. Organ routes to the shared Rotary via the ORGAN button (post-reverb tap, like To Rotary); rotary speed ramps (acceleration), and Stop mode silences the modulation. Programs store/recall the complete canonical state (32 slots + 8 Live) through an injected storage seam; splits gate/attenuate notes per layer with crossfade tails; morphs interpolate assigned destinations through canonical state; the master clock drives arp/LFO sync subdivisions.

notes: One AudioContext: voice sources → six layer buses → ordered effects → layer level gains → master gain (Master Level knob) → limiter → one destination. Organ layers share the 'organ' chain; synth layers own synthA/B/C; piano keeps pianoA/B. Bypass is click-free; parameter changes use short ramps.

Delay feedback filtering is inside the feedback loop. Reverb precedes Rotary; organ routes via its ORGAN button (post-reverb tap) and piano/synth via To Rotary. Rotary slow/fast/stop with acceleration; drive from either panel knob.

Program state is the canonical serializable schema in src/state/program-state.ts (all supported state; Master Level excluded). 32 slots + 8 auto-storing Live slots persist through an injected StorageLike (localStorage in the app). Dirty indicator compares the canonical snapshot; edits are discarded on program change with a single-level undo (optional feature, implemented).

Splits: 3 points at the 11 documented positions, up to 4 zones, per-layer contiguous zone ranges, crossfade Off (hard switch) and ±6/±12 linear fades (0.5 at the boundary with tails across it) applied as note-on gain — observable in rendered audio.

Morphs: Wheel + Control Pedal (virtual pedal + MIDI CC11) with hold/double-tap assignment, from→to interpolation (inverse allowed), green morph LEDs, per-source clear and zero-to-remove. Aftertouch is spec-excluded and listed unsupported.

Spec-excluded controls (move, do nothing, listed in the UI notes and the hardware.bindings audit): program.morphAftertouch, program.panelASelect/BSelect, organ.panelASelect/BSelect, piano.modelSelect, synth.oscMix.

Master clock: tap (4+) and dial, 30–300 BPM, syncing arp/gate rate, synth LFO rate; delay/mod-1 clock targets exist canonically. Transpose ±6 shifts every engine's rendered pitch. Panic stops all voices and resets held inputs.
Per-layer polyphony 16 voices with deterministic stealing; blur/disconnect/unmount/panic stop every owned voice; tests assert voice/timer/listener baselines.
Sustain works from UI, computer keyboard (space), and MIDI CC64, gated per layer by SUSTPED across all three engines.
